departments.description: P S Mission Hospital has a Neonatal I.C.U with 8 beds and divided into high depending area for the high risk children like premature babies, babies with Meningitis, Pneumonia, Sepsis and respiratory distress. We have continuous multi-monitor system, radiant warmer. Arterial blood gas analysis is done as per the requirement of the babies. There is an area of isolation for highly infected babies. In our outpatient department we give immunization all the days except Sunday after concerned doctor’s consultation. We provide baby health care with all growth charts and required information. Optional vaccines like Typhoid, Varicella (Chicken – Pox), Hepatitis A, IPV, Pneumococcal, HPV vaccines will be provided according to the needs of the patients. B.C.G given everyday(except Sunday & Holidays) in the morning OPD

The department of Cardiology at P S Mission Hospital provides medical interventional and non interventional management for all kinds of diseases relating to the heart and the circulatory system. We offer diagnosis and treatments for health issues like heart failures, congenital heart diseases and various other cardiac disorders. Services are provided to ensure quality care to the patients at our affordable rates.

The department of General Medicine at P S Mission Hospital is engaged in the prevention, diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of various diseases. Department is manned by specialists, supporting nursing staff; modern diagnostic services and a 24 hour pharmacy which makes it an all-round solution that patients seek.

P S Mission Hospital has a well-established department of General Surgery manned by a multi-skilled surgeon team adept in performing a wide range of surgeries. All trauma patients are evaluated by the surgical team. Our department also undertakes advanced minimally invasive surgical technique Laparoscopic surgery where the surgeon operates through a single entry point to minimize scars, decrease pain and enable the patient to recover faster. The General Surgery department is supported by round the clock laboratory, ICU, radiology and emergency services to ensure patients receive highest level of care in a timely manner. We take infection prevention and control seriously & our operating rooms are equipped with filtration systems designed to eliminate bacteria from the air, infection-reducing surgical practices, and enhanced sterilization methods Treatments and Procedures Comprehensive care in the areas of: Trauma and accidents Surgical emergencies Laparoscopic surgery Upper gastrointestinal surgery for diseases affecting the liver, oesophagus and stomach, Colorectal surgery for diseases of the colon, rectum and anal canal Endocrine surgery for thyroid and other endocrine glands Breast surgery for any tumours, both benign and malignant Surgical oncology Treatment for haemorrhoids Surgery for gall bladder diseases and gall stones (Cholecystectomy) Surgical treatment of leading ulcers and varicose Appendectomy Our Consultants Dr. Denny P Kuttikkat MBBS, MS, FRCS OP: MONDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY 10AM to 11:30AM Book Now

The P S mission Hospital Orthopaedics & Trauma Care department offers a wide range of services, including knee replacement surgeries, total hip and shoulder replacement surgeries and spine surgeries, as well as various kinds of innovative care for a broad range of musculoskeletal conditions. Our orthopaedic team diagnoses, operates and treats problems affecting the bones, joints and muscles of patients in all age groups. With its fully-equipped operation theatres, intensive care units for pre- and post- operative care, as well as rehabilitation services the Orthopaedics department offers subspecialty expertise, comprehensive services and advanced technology. The state-of-the-art operation theatres are equipped with the latest fracture tables and imaging facilities, including a C-arm image intensifier. Operation Theater has Laminar flow OT.

As one of the first departments started in the hospital the department has full time experienced qualified and dedicated doctors and senior nurses for separate first stage of labour and second stage of labour. Separate nurses are there for each patient in labour & new technology like CTG machines to monitor wellbeing of baby during labour and facility for painless labour. Antenatal OPD morning and evening. Special care for high risk pregnant patients. Ultra-modern USG machine with Colour Doppler to assess well being of baby and timely management. Gynaec OPD is equipped with colposcope for early detection of cancer cervix. Every month third Friday is devoted to health education for pregnant and non-pregnant patients and free distribution of Iron and Calcium tablets. Operation theatre is well equipped to take care of all types of gynaec surgeries including laparoscopic surgeries. Facilities Health Education classes for expectant mothers Painless labour Monthly Free issue of iron and calcium Infertility Treatment High-Risk pregnancy clinic Our Consultants Dr. Susanna Mohan MBBS, DGO, DNB O.P: MONDAY – SATURDAY 09:30AM to 1.00PM Book Now Dr. Bindu Mary George MBBS,MS,(Obstetrics & Gynaecology) OP: MONDAY – SATURDAY 9.30AM-12.30 NOON AND 4.00PM TO 5.30 PM Book Now Dr. P M RAJESWARI MBBS,MD OBG OP: MONDAY – SATURDAY 2AM-4PM Book Now

P S Mission Hospital Emergency Department has well-qualified and experienced doctors and faculty members specialized in accident and emergency medicine to provide quality care round the clock. The department is well equipped with advanced technology like Defibrillator, Cardiac Monitor, Pulse Oximeter, Oxygen Therapy, Suction Apparatus and life-saving medications. We also accept MLC cases. Emergency diagnostic measures like ECG machine, Glucometer, Nebulizer and many other facilities are available in casualty which aids further care. Procedures like stomach wash, Ryles tube insertion, Catherization, Cannulization etc. are done in this department.

The Nephrology Department at PS Mission Hospital is dedicated to the diagnosis & treatment of all types of kidney diseases like acute kidney injury due to any cause and chronic kidney diseases caused by diabetics , hypertension Nephrotic Syndromes,Glomercular nephritis, Lupus nephritis, vasculitis ,Polycystic kidney diseases, kidney stone diseases, urine infection etc . The department is also equipped with a modern dialysis unit which provides treatment for End Stage Kidney Disease, supported by a team of well experienced dialysis technicians and staff nurses.

The Neurology Department at P S Mission Hospital has a dedicated team of doctors along with advanced technology support that provides a comprehensive and multidisciplinary care for Brain and Spine disorders. The treatment is based on protocols of transparent evaluation of outcomes to ensure appropriate patient management.

The department of Dermatology at P S Mission Hospital deals with both clinical and aesthetic sides of Dermatology. All common skin conditions are effectively investigated and managed by the department. The department provides a wide variety of speciality services in Paediatric, Surgical, Medical and Cosmetic Dermatology. Our experts have successfully treated all forms of disfigurements including Skin Cancers and Melanoma to Acne and skin related problems. The department is well equipped to conduct procedures like, Skin Biopsy, Electro Surgery, Radio Frequency Surgery, Cryo Therapy, Chemical Peel, Intra Lesional Injections etc.

Our ENT Department specializes in the evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of a full spectrum of ear, nose and throat disorders, as well as areas within the head and neck. The department works in close collaboration with other the specialties. Our ENT specialists are highly qualified to treat each condition individually & work with a commitment to provide the highest quality care and the most advanced treatments at affordable costs. Our hospital is well equipped with latest diagnostic and surgical instruments, specialized for ENT care and treatment. Facilities Comprehensive and advanced care for all ENT Cases: Diagnostic Facilities including Rigid Endoscopy (A Telescope Attached With A Light To See The ear, nose and throat) All routine ENT surgeries like Mastoidectomy, Rhinoplasty, Septoplasty Services Treatments done for: Hearing loss & Ear Discharge Dizziness/Vertigo Headache & Sinusitis Voice loss Nose Block & Nasal Allergy Paediatric ENT problems Our Consultants Dr. V. T JOSEPH MBBS, DLO, MS OP: TUESDAY,THURSDAY,SATURDAY 10am -11.30am Book Now Dr. Annie Johnny MBBS, MS, DNB OP: MONDAY, WEDNESDAY, SATURDAY 10AM to 12PM Book Now

The P S Mission department of Ophthalmology manages all types of general eye ailments. The department is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure to keep up with the advancement in technology in the evaluation and management of visual impairment and blindness. Our surgeons have undergone specific training and have experience in a broad range of subspecialties like Cornea, Retina, Uvea, Glaucoma, Squint, Neuro-Ophthalmology, Paediatric Ophthalmology, Orbit & Oculoplasty. Services Refraction and prescription of spectacles Slit lamp bio microscopic evaluation of the anterior and posterior segment Applanation tonometry Routine screening for Glaucoma, Diabetic and Hypertensive Retinopathy Retinopathy of Prematurity in premature infants. Routine Ophthalmic work Phaeco (Keyhole) surgery for Cataract

P S Mission Hospital offers state-of-the-art diagnosis and treatment methods for a wide range of adult and paediatric urological conditions, such as Urinary Incontinence, Prostate and Kidney Cancers, Kidney Stones, Male Infertility, Kidney Stones, Prostate Enlargement, Incontinence, Female Bladder problems and Neurogenic Bladder. Our team of highly qualified & experienced urologists has special expertise in minimally invasive treatments for urological disorders.

At our Anaesthesiology department systematic clinical examination done and fitness to undergo surgery assessed for all pre-operative patients. Technique of anaesthesia is planned and preparations advised. Intra operative monitoring, ECG, Non-invasive B.P, Pulse oximetry, and ventilatory support facilities are available here. Regional anaesthetic techniques are also done. All post-operative cases are monitored with routine care, and ventilatory support facilities also provided.

P S Mission Hospital provides a full scope of dental & Maxillo-facial surgery treatments at its Department of Dentistry and Maxillo-facial surgery. Our team includes specialists in Orthodontics, Endodontics, Oral and Maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics and periodontics. The department has been catering to the dental needs of children, teens, adults and even patients with special health care needs. From common paediatric conditions like chipped tooth and overbites to more complex surgical treatments, our team of experts are equipped with years of experience to handle anything, with utmost care. Backed by a post-op rehabilitation and care team, the Department of Dentistry and Maxillo-facial surgery delivers smiles to our patients. Services Single sitting Root canal treatment in adults and both Pulpectomy and Pulpotomy in children. Cosmetic dentistry including jacket crown veneers, tooth jewellery with skyce, teeth whitening using home and office bleach, correction of high smile line etc. Immediate correction of irregular teeth within two weeks Gum disease correction treatments include flap surgery with Bone Andor Soft Tissue Grafting, Frenal Correction, Double Lip Correction, and Gummy Smile Correction Ceramic crowns and bridges along with precision attachments RPD and Full dentures Cast partial dentures and Flexlite partial dentures Management of all immediate facial trauma emergencies. Surgery like impacted Tooth Extractions, Apicoectomy. Surgical excision of cyst, growth, tumours of bone and skin etc. Management of all facial trauma injuries Fixed and removable Orthodontics with myofunctional appliances Tooth coloured composite fillings and amalgam fillings Jaw pain management with different treatment modalities Facilities Orthodontic – correction of irregular teeth Correction of congenital abnormalities like palate, lip jaw irregularities Root Canal Treatment Our Consultants Dr.Yelna Davis BDS, Dental Laser Specialist & Esthetic Dentist TUESDAY – FRIDAY 9.30M – 12.30PM Book Now Dr. Liny Jaimson BDS MONDAY -THURSDAY O.P: 9.30M – 12.30PM SATURDAY 9.30AM – 12.30PM Book Now Dr. Augustine Daniel BDS, MDS (PERIO) MDS (OFMS) OP: FRIDAY 9.30AM to 1PM Book Now

P S Mission Hospital Department of Physical medicine and Rehabitation is well equipped with latest equipment working on various sub specialties of physiotherapy. Our qualified, experienced and well trained team of physio and occupational therapists offer Services in wards and intensive care units with treatment procedure of international standards to offer a multifaceted approach to the patient’s rehabilitation.

The Radiology & Imaging division at P S Mission Hospital constitutes of a team of experts who are committed to provide high quality radio-diagnosis to the patients and referring physicians. The department is backed with latest generation technology, skilled technicians, highly qualified doctors, and supporting staff and delivers impeccable results in radio imaging. We ensure to support our physicians and surgeons diagnose the most complicated cases with accurate and timely results.

The Psychiatry Department at P S Mission Hospital is dedicated to provide better clinical care for mental conditions affecting individuals across the age spectrum with severe and diverse illnesses. The Department offers a variety of clinical interests in Biological Psychiatry, Pharmacotherapy & Behaviour Therapy including Cognitive Therapy. A speciality clinic within the Department is dedicated to help people with substance dependence issues.
